reviews.title: Seems very efficient
reviews.text:
Edit: I have downgraded my rating as I got logged out and cannot get back in for an app that I paid for. I keep trying to reset my password and the reset email never arrives. Been checking for over half an hour. Of course without being logged in there seems to be no way to contact any customer service either!!!! They are thieves since I have paid for a service that they are not providing me a way to access.

I have been using this app for a short amount of time. There is at least one feature that I believe most everyone would find helpful to have added…the ability to indicate items (or a portion of the item) that are already going to be used in planned meals. I do my meal planning on Wednesday, put together my grocery order for pickup on Saturdays (if not done early I don’t get the time slot needed based upon my work schedule). I found myself having to review what my meal plans are to make sure that items in my freezer or pantry are not needed for a recipe. The other feature which I know would benefit me and perhaps a few others is if it would integrate with eMeals and my WalMart grocery app (don’t expect this as it would require a lot of coordination between many different companies as you couldn’t just go with one grocery order app or meal planning app).

reviews.title: Really handy, but gross that you charge money to add any more than 200 items…
reviews.text: Please don’t mess with a good thing lol, it works amazing as it is, update it if you need to but the way you can scan everything in and it usually knows exactly what it is is so cool, and in the event it doesn’t, I like that I can contribute a picture and some info, and then it WILL be recognized by someone else’s app, keep this the way it is more or less and I’ll keep using it

reviews.title: Store checkout doesn’t work
reviews.text: Whether I’m in the store or outside of the store, I can’t check out with my items. It says looking for location as in the stores location. It doesn’t matter what store I use. Costco, Smith’s, Nel’s Bilo or Fred Meyer’s

reviews.title: Not family friendly
reviews.text: When my husband and I paid for the panzy app we fully expected it to have a login option so we could log into the same account on our iphones. We each have our own iCloud account and  there is evidently no way to link our use of the app. What good does that do us when we share cooking and shopping? Plus there is no contact or support for the app. Very very disappointed.
